scenarios.title: Verified cooling fit — open window
scenarios.description: A verified water-cooled architecture requirement matches a verified synthetic compressor capability.

scenarios.title: Verified electrical fit — open window
scenarios.description: A verified incoming-voltage requirement matches a verified synthetic switchgear capability.

scenarios.title: Multi-family project comparison
scenarios.description: Building-management and medium-voltage families are evaluated independently for one synthetic opportunity.

scenarios.title: Verified hard technical mismatch
scenarios.description: A verified 33 kV project requirement exceeds the verified synthetic switchgear capability.

scenarios.title: Missing project requirement
scenarios.description: The project incoming-voltage fact is unknown, so the product family cannot be evaluated as fit.

scenarios.title: Unverified product capability
scenarios.description: The project requirement is verified but the synthetic product capability remains unverified.

scenarios.title: Conflicting capability evidence
scenarios.description: Two synthetic capability claims conflict and remain visible without selecting the favorable side.

scenarios.title: Verified fit — closing window
scenarios.description: The technical fit is verified while the synthetic project has reached the closing tender stage.

scenarios.title: Verified fit — closed window
scenarios.description: The technical fit remains visible but the synthetic specification window is closed after award.

scenarios.title: Retrofit opportunity
scenarios.description: A verified protocol fit is evaluated under the bounded retrofit-open window policy.

scenarios.title: Incompatible technical unit
scenarios.description: The project fact uses an incompatible quantity dimension and requires domain review.

scenarios.title: No evaluable technical requirements
scenarios.description: The synthetic opportunity has no candidate family or evaluable requirement and remains explicitly not evaluated.
